confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated Italy-wide and Milan/Rome guide figures plus a few Como-area sources. No Como-specific price index was found, so I applied a tourist-town uplift. Cocktail and wine anchors are weakly sourced: cocktails use Milan and Turin crowd-sourced figures, and wine uses bar prices, not restaurant prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not based on searches, and I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings. The EUR-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.15 that I did not verify by search. The fx observation is the 2026-03-20 value that a search result reported from the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open the page or confirm it is the latest observation on 2026-10-16, so the official latest RBA F11.1 value should be checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Como is a lakeside tourist town in northern Lombardy. Restaurant and coffee anchors are based on Italian national averages and Milan benchmarks, adjusted upward for lake-view and tourist-area pricing. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a small, high-demand lakeside Italian town in summer.
